annotations.title: Find Largest ICE and CBP Awards

description: The largest ICE and CBP awards in the Pay-to-Play Register: awards funded by the component with a transaction in FY2025 or FY2026, ranked by Award Amount. Filter by component (ICE or CBP), fiscal year (2025 or 2026), recipient name substring, or the law File C records for the award (PL119-21, PL119-98 or account_level_only); limit 1-50 (default 20). Each award gives the recipient, its parent, the Award Amount and outlays (both lifetime figures), the award description verbatim from the award record, and the File C law link with its class (labelled or probable) or "account level only"; total and truncated give the full count. Award Amount is the award's lifetime amount, not an FY2025-26 obligation, and is never added to the fiscal-year contract totals. A File C law link records the account the award was charged to, not a judgment about the award.

component.description: Optional funding component: ICE or CBP.

fy.description: Optional fiscal year with a transaction on the award: 2025 or 2026.

law.description: Optional File C law link: PL119-21, PL119-98 or account_level_only (no File C row in the two laws' accounts).

recipient.description: Optional case-insensitive recipient or parent name substring, at most 80 characters.

name: pay_to_play_awards
